claims: Selection Sunday 2026 for the NCAA Division I men's and women's basketball tournaments takes place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The men’s bracket is revealed at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The Men's Selection Show is at 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 15, 2026 on CBS.
The Women's Selection Show is on Sunday, March 15, 2026 on ESPN.
The Final Four is on April 4 and April 6, 2026 in Indianapolis, IN.
